from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyPaymentReport(BaseModel):
    """Cash payment to employees extracted from one company's financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as reported in the document")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The amount for 'cash paid to employees and for employees'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., 2024年第一季度")
    label: str | None = Field(description="The line item label as written in the report")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short excerpt from the report containing this figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_payment_reports: list[CompanyPaymentReport]
